summary: Implemented only the RDGO-001 v3.0 section 6 Gate-5 integration frozen by .1R.9 section 16.1 slice 1. New src/pcae/core/runtime_dispatch_gate5.py: the Option C (layered) Gate-5 approval-validation coordinator run_gate5, the single owner of "Gate 5 ran", sequencing the already-independently-verified sub-checks in RIHAC-001 v2.0 section 16 order (approval validation via runtime_authority.validate_approval; principal provenance plus full HPAC-REQ-054 reverification including Step-4 independent challenge-digest recomputation via the mechanism-neutral HPAC verifier through validate_approval mandatory reverify_authenticated_principal call, plus an upfront is_verifier_authenticated_principal precheck), confirming the HPAC lifecycle sequence-3 PROOF_VERIFIED_AND_BOUND binding (HPAC-REQ-097) via the new read-only HPACLifecycleStore.resolve_gate5_binding_event, and owning the fail-closed envelope. Output is the ephemeral non-transferable ValidatedAuthorityProjection plus an identity-only, non-serializable, constructor-sealed, process-local-registry-provenanced Gate5Result: never a boolean, bearer token, or caller-copyable seal. Consumes nothing (approval bytes unchanged, no consumption.json anywhere, no Gate-9 primitive called) and is idempotently repeatable. The NON-REAL hard stop is inherited, not re-implemented (validate_approval line ~1093): the fully wired coordinator returns fail-closed in production for every real request; a complete deterministic local HPAC chain still fails on non_real_authenticated_principal_cannot_validate_production_approval and never reaches a Gate5Result, PB request, or Gate-9 consumption. Minimal read-only wiring: runtime_authority.trusted_projection_gate5_binding and HPACLifecycleStore.resolve_gate5_binding_event; no schema, genesis, twelve-step, NON-REAL hard stop, or trust-predicate change. Finding IF-1: primary source showed the sequence-3 write is already wired through the verifier mandatory HPAC-REQ-054 step 10 (assurance-independent by contract design, not authority per HPAC-REQ-097 section 40.2), so the coordinator owns sequence-3 by confirmation plus binding compare plus digest capture, not a duplicate write; recorded, no STOP triggered, no architecture redesigned. No Gate-6 PB / Gate-7 / Gate-8 / Gate-9 consumption / Gate-10; no normative contract modified (git diff docs/contracts empty); POL-005 hard DENY untouched; runtime remains not_implemented / Observed / observe / unavailable; the new coordinator imports nothing effectful (AST-verified). 29 new focused defensive tests (rejection-only plus structural, per .1R.9 section 41).
